fields.Name: IT175 - Saved-Query Metadata Not Loaded Into Metadata
fields.Description: A GraphQL client session, configured as a browser is by default, leaves the saved-query items of the MJ_Metadata dataset unread and gets saved queries from QueryEngine. QM1 the deprecated Queries / QueryFields getters are empty, MJ: Queries is not a metadata member while MJ: Entities is, and the session's QueryEngine holds the saved queries; QM2 the server's metadata status reports no rows for the skipped MJ: Queries item and still reports the MJ: Entities rows; QM3 a query saved by a second session leaves the first session's metadata current. QM3 is mutating and self-cleaning.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: Saved-query metadata comes from QueryEngine, and saving a query never makes a client's metadata stale.
